(lambda (r) (= (at grid r c2) color)) (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))) (define (interior-cells-of-frame obj) (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj))) (positions-in-rect (+ (first bb) 1) (+ (second bb) 1) (- (third bb) 1) (- (fourth bb) 1)))) (define (frame-seeds grid obj) (let ((wall (obj-color obj))) (filter (lambda (p) (let ((v (at grid (first p) (second p)))) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v wall))))) (interior-cells-of-frame obj)))) (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0))) ((frame (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (rect-frame? g o)) (objects g 0))))) (let ((seeds (frame-seeds g frame))) (if (= (length seeds) 1) (let* ((bb (obj-bbox frame)) (cr (quotient (+ (first bb) (third bb)) 2)) (cc (quotient (+ (second bb) (fourth bb)) 2)) (seed (first seeds))) (set-cell out cr cc (at g (first seed) (second seed)))) out))))))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b))
          (< (second a) (second b))
          (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (paint-if-zero out r c)
      (if (= (at out r c) 0) (set-cell out r c 1) out))
    (define (paint-segment out a b)
      (let* ((r1 (first a)) (c1 (second a))
             (r2 (first b)) (c2 (second b))
             (after-h
              (for/fold ((acc out))
                        ((c (in-list (range (min c1 c2) (+ (max c1 c2) 1)))))
                (paint-if-zero acc r1 c)))
             (after-v
              (for/fold ((acc after-h))
                        ((r (in-list (range (min r1 r2) (+ (max r1 r2) 1)))))
                (paint-if-zero acc r c2))))
        after-v))
    (define points
      (sort
       (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0))) (grid-cells centers))
       cell<))
    (let loop ((remaining points) (out centers))
      (if (or (empty? remaining) (empty? (rest remaining)))
          out
          (loop (rest remaining)
                (paint-segment out (first remaining) (second remaining)))))))
